summary: Proof of Theorem 1.1: In sentence [p4-6], the authors define an automorphism $\varphi$ of $H$ by choosing a non-trivial automorphism of $\text{span}\{x_i\}_{i<n}$ and setting $\varphi(y) = y$ for all $y \in Y$. However, $H$ is not the internal direct sum of $\text{span}(Y)$ and $\text{span}\{x_i\}_{i<n}$, so this map is not well-defined unless $\text{span}(Y) \cap \text{span}\{x_i\}_{i<n} = \{0\}$
